block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Hardware-style diagnostic tripwire latch matrix defining reaction policies without crude runtime aborts.
what_it_enables: Hardware-style latched tripwire traps replacing crude runtime abort() crashes
Graceful degradation and fallback policies (e.g. X11 to CLI, missing JSON to monolith)
Automated post-mortem diagnostic dumps and time-travel rewind triggers
invariants: Tripwires must never call abort() or exit() during normal simulation runs
All tripwire reactions must maintain memory boundary integrity
Universal 5-Block Lifecycle Protocol enforced across all definitions

tripwires.name: Zero-Heap Allocation Invariant
tripwires.trigger_condition: Layer 0 or Layer 1 executes dynamic heap allocation
tripwires.fallback_action: Freeze simulation, dump CARD_ENGINE_HEARTBEAT and CARD_TRIPWIRE_DIAGNOSTIC to console and log.
tripwires.developer_action: Audit callstack for rogue malloc() or dynamic container instantiation.

tripwires.name: Frame Delta Lag Spike Defense
tripwires.fallback_action: Clamp simulation accumulator delta to 100 ms maximum to prevent physics spiral of death.
tripwires.developer_action: Profile frame pacing and background I/O operations.

tripwires.name: Data Pipeline Manifest Missing
tripwires.trigger_condition: Manifest JSON file unreadable or absent from disk
tripwires.fallback_action: Engage C11 hardcoded monolithic defaults from fallback headers.
tripwires.developer_action: Restore missing manifest.json in data directory tree.

tripwires.name: Native X11 Server Disconnection
tripwires.trigger_condition: XOpenDisplay returns NULL or X11 socket disconnects
tripwires.fallback_action: Gracefully shut down X11 window and switch active presentation router to terminal CLI mode.
tripwires.developer_action: Verify X11 server connectivity or launch explicitly with --cli.

tripwires.name: Statera Moral Sway Invariant
tripwires.fallback_action: Clamp moral sway strictly to [-100, +100] continuum and record consequence breadcrumb.
tripwires.developer_action: Audit Conscience Ledger moral sway adjustment delta.

tripwires.name: Twin Relics Resonance Saturation
tripwires.fallback_action: Clamp relic resonance strictly at 100 and emit acoustic/visual saturation ping.
tripwires.developer_action: Verify charge gain formulas in combat and item consumption.

tripwires.name: Protagonist Fatal Blow Defense
tripwires.fallback_action: Capture emergency snapshot #63, trigger interactive debugger REPL, offer turn rewind.
tripwires.developer_action: Check damage mitigation formulas and enemy threat balancing.

tripwires.name: Stance FSM Transition Guard
tripwires.trigger_condition: Requested stance transition is not a valid edge in the stance graph
tripwires.fallback_action: Reject command, retain previous valid stance, log warning breadcrumb to GAME_STANCES.
tripwires.developer_action: Verify unit stance finite state machine edge table in combat.c.

tripwires.name: Floppy Safe-Mode Read-Only Write Guard
tripwires.trigger_condition: Disk write or mkdir attempted while Floppy Read-Only latch is armed
tripwires.fallback_action: Block disk I/O cleanly, increment read_only_blocks, keep telemetry in RAM ring, and await if debug probe active.
tripwires.developer_action: Inspect caller attempting write/mkdir during Floppy RO Safe Mode or clear read-only policy latch.

tripwires.name: Zero-Heap I/O Buffer & Policy Bounds Guard
tripwires.trigger_condition: Payload exceeds buffer tier cap or loaded I/O policy fails monotonic ladder bounds
tripwires.fallback_action: Reject truncated/corrupt policy cleanly, restore Safe-Mode ROM policy, and flag debug probe if armed.
tripwires.developer_action: Check buffer sizing against fs_buffers.json limits or restore malformed config JSON.

tripwires.name: Config ROM Vault Envelope Integrity Guard
tripwires.trigger_condition: Compiled .rodata ROM asset fails 5-block validation or disk policy parity fallback occurs
tripwires.fallback_action: Hydrate emergency Safe-Mode BIOS template with loaded_from_data=false and log diagnostic fault.
tripwires.developer_action: Inspect engine/config/io/*.json schema integrity and rerun CMake GenerateConfigRom.

tripwires.name: Zero-Heap JSON Syntax & Policy Integrity Guard
tripwires.trigger_condition: Unterminated string/container, illegal escape, or invalid json_policy_t encountered in inspection or validation
tripwires.fallback_action: Abort token parse safely, restore ROM Safe-Mode parser policy, record IO_ERR_JSON_SYNTAX telemetry, and trap io.json.syntax -> DEBUG_STEP_AWAIT.
tripwires.developer_action: Validate JSON syntax, quotes, escape sequences, and loader_contracts bounds.

tripwires.name: Zero-Heap JSON Nesting Depth Guard
tripwires.trigger_condition: Nested JSON object/array bracket depth exceeds active max_json_depth policy ceiling (<= 32)
tripwires.fallback_action: Abort deep recursive block scan cleanly, record IO_ERR_JSON_DEPTH_EXCEEDED telemetry, and trap io.json.depth_bounds -> DEBUG_STEP_AWAIT.
tripwires.developer_action: Flatten deeply nested JSON hierarchy within max_json_depth or inspect corrupted brackets.
